VaultDocket.title: VaultDocket
VaultDocket.description: Legal and strategic case docket tracked across the 4-Phase Loop Engine and 7 Justice Vault Modules.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this docket.

title.description: Short tactical title of the legal or bioscience case.

caseSummary.description: Raw facts, blotter summary, or agency complaint details.

moduleTag.description: One of the 7 Justice Vault Modules or BIOSCIENCE.

phase.description: Current step in the 4-Phase Loop Engine.

planeStatus.description: Dual-plane classification: MORTAL (working draft) or IMMORTAL (sealed).

rulingText.description: Verdict-grade legal/strategic guidance rendered by Vault 1293.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Multi-turn Sovereign Vault 1293 chat message and MGD deliberation record.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this message.

content.description: Full text content of the message or verdict.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model identifier used to generate the verdict.

groundingSources.description: Formatted search or maps grounding citations if applicable.

createdAt.description: Message creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

BioscienceAudit.title: BioscienceAudit
BioscienceAudit.description: Bioscience, forensics, environmental, and medico-legal lab audit entry.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this bioscience audit.

sampleName.description: Name or location of sample (e.g., Bacoor Zapote River Water Sample).

bioscienceCategory.description: Category of bioscience analysis (e.g., Toxicology, Water Quality, Medico-Legal DNA, Food Safety).

regulatoryCitation.description: Philippine environmental/health/forensic law citation (e.g., RA 9275 Clean Water Act, FDA Act RA 9711).

/vault_dockets/{docketId}.description: Root collection storing per-user legal and strategic dockets across the 4-Phase Loop Engine.

/chat_messages/{messageId}.description: Root collection storing per-user Sovereign Vault 1293 chat history and MGD engine deliberations.

/bioscience_audits/{auditId}.description: Root collection storing per-user Bioscience & Forensics Lab audits.
